description: Returns the cancellation terms for one rate plan at an OpenTravel partner hotel: whether it is refundable, the free-cancellation window, the refund percentage, a plain-language summary and, given the check-in date, the exact free-cancellation deadline. Takes the propertyId and the ratePlanId from get_hotel_detail.

checkInDate.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD — required to compute the exact free-cancel deadline

language.description: Reply language. Falls back to queryText, then English.

propertyId.description: OpenTravel propertyId UUID from search results

queryText.description: Short excerpt of the guest's request, used only to pick the reply language.

name: get_cancellation_policy
title: Get Cancellation Policy
